spans.text: [16] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ EN: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise.

[11] AR: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًۭا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ EN: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it."

folded.id: you|will|not possess for me [the power of protection] from allah at all
folded.subject: you
folded.object: not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all

spans.text: Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all.
